name: @sig-net/midnight-examples-erc20-vault-client
description: Node runtime client for the ERC20 vault: the compiled-contract binding over the contract package's compiler output, and the midnight-js provider set built around a wallet. The half of the vault's client surface that cannot be environment-agnostic, so it sits beside the contract package rather than inside it.
//exports: Local dev consumes raw TS source. `publishConfig.exports` below swaps this to the emitted ./dist at publish time, so npm consumers get JS + .d.ts while the workspace keeps resolving to src.
